recommendedTextbook.title: Cultural and Creative Arts for Junior Secondary Schools Book 3
recommendedTextbook.author: I. N. C. Aniekwe, S. O. Babalola
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

topics.topic: Contemporary Nigerian Artists and Modern Art Pioneers
subtopics: Pioneers of modern Nigerian art: Aina Onabolu (academic realism) and Akinola Lasekan (political cartoons)
The Zaria Art Society ('Natural Synthesis', 1958): Uche Okeke, Bruce Onobrakpeya, Demas Nwoko
Ben Enwonwu (African modernist sculptor and painter) and famous public monuments (Sango in Lagos)
objectives: Analyze Aina Onabolu's contribution to formal art education in colonial Nigeria
Explain the concept of 'Natural Synthesis' formulated by the Zaria Rebels
Evaluate Ben Enwonwu's bronze statue of Queen Elizabeth II and bronze Sango at NEPA headquarters

topics.topic: Choreography, Dance Notation and Nigerian Ceremonial Dances
subtopics: Concept of choreography and movement design in space, time, and dynamic energy
Traditional ceremonial dances: Atilogwu dance (Igbo acrobatic), Bata dance (Yoruba religious), Koroso dance (Hausa/Fulani celebratory)
Staging a contemporary cultural dance drama celebrating national unity
objectives: Define choreography and state 3 fundamental tools of a dance choreographer
Describe the cultural symbolism and musical instruments accompanying the Atilogwu dance
Choreograph a 4-minute synchronized group dance sequence to traditional percussion rhythms

topics.topic: Applied Arts: Graphic Design, Packaging and Advertising
subtopics: Fundamentals of graphic design: Lettering (block, gothic, roman, script), poster design, logo design
Product packaging: Branding, label layout, barcodes, NAFDAC registration numbering conventions
Advertising media: Billboards, newspaper spreads, social media banners, TV commercials
objectives: Design a completed hand-lettered promotional poster for an intra-school science exhibition
Construct a 3-dimensional cardboard package prototype for a local fruit beverage
Explain how color psychology and visual hierarchy influence consumer buying behavior

topics.topic: Art Exhibition, Gallery Presentation and Portfolio Curation
subtopics: Planning a school art exhibition: Mounting, framing, labeling (artist, title, medium, date, price)
Gallery etiquette, lighting, curation flow, and opening ceremonies
Assembling a student art and craft portfolio for the Basic Education Certificate Examination (BECE)
objectives: Mount a 2D still-life drawing with standard matting and caption card
Curate a classroom art display following visual aesthetic spacing guidelines
Present a curated portfolio containing drawing, painting, craft, and musical transcriptions for grading
